notes: Not a historical-evidence miss - the Phase 6 impossible-count anomaly (testsSelectedByDiffci > testsTotal). Root cause: no code in the pipeline ever checks the repo out to a delta's specific headSha; tests/performance.test.tsx was later renamed to tests/perf/performance.test.ts, so the tip-state test-file scan misses it under its historical name while the headSha-independent git diff correctly reports it as added. Reproduced deterministically; fixed via a non-clamping testCountInvariantViolation guard (runner.ts/aggregator.ts) - see docs/research/2026-08-21-stage1a-valtio-anomaly.md.
